data.title: Jobs & Work — Beginner · Lesson 3
data.subject: jobs
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Woke up with the sun in my eyes…

[Hook]
Sunny day… Día soleado
At the beach… En la playa
Waves are calling… Las olas llaman
Let's work and play… Vamos a trabajar y a jugar
Let's learn today.

[Verse]
The shoemaker… El zapatero
Fixing shoes by the shore.
The butcher… El carnicero
Grilling meat, who could want more?
The fruit vendor… El frutero
Selling mangoes and limes.
The dressmaker… La modista
Sewing dreams in no time.

[Hook]
Sunny day… Día soleado
At the beach… En la playa
Waves are calling… Las olas llaman
Let's work and play… Vamos a trabajar y a jugar
Let's learn today.

[Verse]
The locksmith… El cerrajero
Keys jingling in his hand.
The florist… El florista
Making bouquets from the sand.
The seamstress… La costurera
Stitching smiles so bright.
The blacksmith… El herrero
Forging dreams in the light.

[Bridge]
The driver… El chofer
Cruising down the coast.
The boss… El jefe
Calling out goals like a ghost.
We’re learning and working… Aprendiendo y trabajando
